post.summary: Previews a proposed JSON Schema without applying it
post.description:
Project credentials with documents:read and documents:write only. Raw schema body, at most 64 KiB; repeat identical bytes with next_cursor as cursor. Counts are page-only, at most 100 documents/1 MiB (one larger document is allowed). At most 16 SHA-256 ID/path diagnostics, no values. Continuation requires the same process, schema and local database frontier; 409 preview_stale or 400 invalid_cursor requires restarting. An observational local result, not a globally serialized gate; later writes can stale it. Applying remains prospective.

Required JWT scopes: documents:read, documents:write.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding page; repeat the same schema on the same node.

parameters.name: X-TerraScale-Region-Pin
parameters.description: Optional single raw region ID. An empty, duplicate or mismatched pin returns 421 before execution; behind the edge a mismatched pin also answers ts-replay: region=<pin>.
